name: kinesis-video-signaling
description: Kinesis Video Streams Signaling Service is a intermediate service that establishes a communication channel for discovering peers, transmitting offers and answers in order to establish peer-to-peer connection in webRTC technology

subcommands.name: get-ice-server-config
subcommands.description: Gets the Interactive Connectivity Establishment (ICE) server configuration information, including URIs, username, and password which can be used to configure the WebRTC connection.

options.name: --channel-arn
options.description: The ARN of the signaling channel to be used for the peer-to-peer connection between configured peers

options.name: --username
options.description: An optional user ID to be associated with the credentials

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: send-alexa-offer-to-master
subcommands.description: This API allows you to connect WebRTC-enabled devices with Alexa display devices.

options.name: --channel-arn
options.description: The ARN of the signaling channel by which Alexa and the master peer communicate

options.name: --sender-client-id
options.description: The unique identifier for the sender client

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.
